newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Citibank sets up A$500 mln funding programme.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Citibank sets up A$500 mln funding programme.

text.p: Citibank Ltd in Australia said it has set up a A$500 million funding programme and issues off it are expected to start in April.
"We will be issuing in a number of tranches with a minimum size of A$100 million," said Michael Cunningham, head of money markets and funding at CitiBank.
The programme has a dual configuration of medium term notes and transferable certificates of deposit, which Cunningham said would help maxmise investor appeal.
Issues were expected to have maturities of three to five years depending where the best investors demand was, he added.
